body.x: Laser measurement startup, Magpie Tech’s (CEO Woong-cheol Shin) child growth management solution ‘Kiko’ will be receiving the innovation award in the digital health sector of the largest electronic product exhibition, CES 2023. The CES Innovation Award is selected and awarded annually to products that showcase the most outstanding technology and innovation by a world-renowned technology expert judging panel organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA).

‘Kiko’ is a total growth management solution for children. It is equipped with a laser extensometer and a smart scale that measures children’s height and weight, and an application that will record the child’s growth will be provided as well. In particular, the laser extensometer is a laser-based height measurement device that is capable of conveniently measuring the child’s height in one second with a 3mm of range of uncertainty. The smart scale supports more professional growth management for children by measuring not only weight but also 8 body components.

The KIKO solution is expected to help establish new obesity standards for children and adolescents. Mountain View Pediatrics, located in Arizona, USA, and Epic Health Group signed an MOU with Magpie Tech in order to establish the obesity diagnosis standard based on big data and to adopt a smart EMR system that links data through the Kiko solution.
In Korea, the aforementioned product will be officially launched on the country's largest crowdfunding platform, 'Wadiz', in December 2022 with goals of introducing the product to domestic consumers.

Woong-Cheol Shin, CEO of Magpie Tech Co., Ltd., said, “Kiko was developed to manage our children’s health within our home, and the fact that we received the CES innovation award shows that our continuous effort trying to supply the market with our professional solution was recognized.”
Meanwhile, ‘Kiko’, which received the CES 2023 award will be exhibited in CES 2023 from the 5th of January to the 8th of January.
